location.site_description: Off Interstate 65 in Montgomery, across from the Hyundai automotive assembly plant

actions.government_body: Office of Alabama Governor Kay Ivey
actions.summary: Governor announced Meta's planned Montgomery data center: more than $800 million investment, 715,000-square-foot AI-optimized campus, approximately 100 jobs, off I-65 across from Hyundai; site already being cleared and expected online at end of 2026.

Meta announced Montgomery, Alabama as a new owned-and-operated data center campus; initial campus size 715,000 square feet, more than $800 million investment, approximately 100 jobs, 100% renewable-energy support, and LEED Gold target once operational.

ADEM public notice states Dotier, LLC applied for synthetic minor operating permits for two groups of emergency diesel-fired engines at 1055 Hyundai Boulevard, Montgomery, AL 36105, facility no. 209-0108.

Meta announced two additional Montgomery Data Center buildings, raising campus footprint to nearly 1.3 million square feet and total investment to more than $1.5 billion; Meta reported more than 1,000 skilled trade workers on site at peak construction.

PSC public access remarks show staff recommended approval of Alabama Power's Clearview Ranch Project and the accompanying Renewable Subscription Program contract between Alabama Power Company and Dotier, LLC.

Alabama Power says Clearview Ranch will include 200 MW solar and 200 MW battery storage in Macon and Bullock counties; Meta supports the project through the Renewable Subscription Program and receives the renewable energy credits.

capacity_notes: No first-party source found disclosing data-center IT/load capacity in MW. Public sources disclose campus footprint only: 715,000 square feet at May 2024 announcement, expanded to nearly 1.3 million square feet in September 2025. Alabama Power discloses separate renewable support projects, not data-center capacity.
owner: Meta Platforms, Inc. / Meta Data Centers; ADEM permittee: Dotier, LLC

sources.match_reason: Seed-only record independently verified against Meta, Alabama Governor, ADEM, Alabama Power, and PSC public sources

contradictions.details: May 2024 sources describe the initial project as 715,000 square feet and more than $800 million; September 2025 Meta expansion announcement supersedes this with nearly 1.3 million square feet and more than $1.5 billion total investment.
contradictions.resolution: Treat September 23, 2025 Meta announcement as current campus buildout scope.
